4) Settings.jsx lacked in-page category/tab navigation, stranding administrators on the default 'modulesSettings' with zero UI controls to access or switch to the other 25+ setting panels (AI providers, Firebase, Database & persistence engine, payment gateways, orders, branding, SEO, feature flags, code injection, templates, etc.).
SCOPE:
1) Build an executive Cuba-grade Settings Navigation Hub directly inside Settings.jsx:
   - Category selector pills for all 6 groups matching the screenshot.
   - Search filter for rapid lookup of all 26+ configuration modules.
   - Tab buttons/chips with icons and active status indicators.
   - Seamless deep-linking with reactive URL search param ?tab=<key>.
   - Superadmin privilege & permission gating preserved.
2) Enhance Superadmin portal navigation & command palette (portalNavigation.js, portalCommands.js, or sidebar) so all 26+ settings modules are discoverable, indexed, and directly navigable.
3) Full runtime verification of all 26+ setting panels rendering and operating cleanly without crash or regression.

plan.summary: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (evidence-based; no code changed). Cuba is the DEFAULT shell (cubaShellFlag.js:58 returns 'cuba' whenever nothing valid is stored), and Admin.jsx:712 renders the legacy Sidebar ONLY when !isCubaChrome. That Sidebar owns SETTINGS_GROUPS (sidebar.jsx:75-119) = 6 groups / 31 settings surfaces and navigates via navigate('/admin/settings?tab=<key>') (sidebar.jsx:209-211). Under Cuba, AdminPortalCuba.jsx:42 renders ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION, whose 'System Configuration' group (portalNavigation.js:177-183) exposes exactly ONE entry {to:'/admin/settings', permission:'*'} with NO ?tab. Settings.jsx:184 defaults activeTab to 'modulesSettings' and the component has NO internal rail/tabs/drawer. NET EFFECT: a Super Admin reaches /admin/settings and sees only 'Addon Modules'; the other ~30 surfaces (Firebase, Database, AI providers, Payments, Security, Feature Flags, Platform Config, Code Injection, GDPR, Templates, Pages, Blog, Analytics, Ads) have NO navigable path in the default shell. ALL_SETTINGS (Settings.jsx:40-74) declares 33 keys; SETTINGS_GROUPS declares 31; facebookAuthSettings and paymentSettings exist only in ALL_SETTINGS. SEVERITY: reachability/UX defect, NOT a security hole - authorization is already enforced twice (RequireTabPerm required='*' in Admin.jsx, plus SettingsWrapper isDenied gate at Settings.jsx:192-195 for superAdminOnly/permission). Restoring navigation therefore CANNOT widen access. PLAN: add a Cuba-glassmorphism in-page settings navigator INSIDE Settings.jsx driven by the existing ALL_SETTINGS array (single source of truth) and filtered by the SAME hasPerm/superAdminOnly logic the wrapper already uses, so no second client-side authorization opinion can disagree with the server; then give the existing 'System Settings' rail entry a deep-link so it lands on the first permitted tab instead of a bare default. No backend change; no new permission semantics; secret masking untouched.

S8 Verify zero secret leakage: confirm no settings component is modified and that masked keys remain masked in both the DOM and the API payloads.
